name: took
description: Local-first CLI + Claude Code plugin that coaches anyone steering AI coding agents through the RePPIT workflow (Research → Propose → Plan → Implement → Test). A coach, never an agent — it reviews every action and tells you, in plain English, what you did, what you should have done, and how to improve.

plugins.name: took
plugins.description: Adds slash commands (/took:prompt, /took:diff, /took:pr-ready, /took:explain, /took:cost, /took:task, /took:recall, and more) and pre/post-tool hooks: guards risky calls and gives a plain-English retrospective on every action (what you did · should have done · how to improve, + XP) — right in your Claude Code session. Auto-syncs your derived XP + readiness + token-to-outcome cost ledger to your dashboard once you're logged in.
